headline: R24 consumed R23 P1(universe)+P2(episode-level) jointly on the honest maximum measurable filing universe (677 DART-filing-covered tickers; the FULL ~2500 filer universe is unreachable without DART API this round). The FROZEN pre-registered PRIMARY (worst_decile_late = per-fy p90 & delay>0) NOMINALLY collapsed to 'any late filer' (1105 episodes/528 firms) because <10% of firms file late in most fiscal years => per-fy p90<=0; on that diluted operationalization the prediction is NOT established (lift 1.23, firm-bootstrap CI [0.86,1.62] includes 1, controlled OR w/ year-FE 2.34 p=0.051 just misses, no-FE OR 1.33 p=0.14). BUT the R23 power wall IS resolved: the signal is unambiguously EXTREME-TAIL, and the strict top-decile-by-rank diagnostic (29 episodes / 27 INDEPENDENT firms / 6 events) shows lift 10.0x, firm-bootstrap CI [3.5,17.3] EXCLUDING 1, controlled OR 6.2 (year-FE) p<0.001, and is LEAVE-ONE-FIRM-OUT ROBUST (drop any of 27 firms => min OR 5.38, max p 0.004) with events spread across 2012-2023 (NOT a COVID artifact). Independent event-firms went 6 (R23, LOO 3/6 decisive, boot CI included 1) -> 27 (R24, LOO all-survive, boot CI excludes 1): a genuine power/inference resolution. Goalpost discipline: the FROZEN primary governs the verdict (NOT ESTABLISHED); the robust extreme-tail result licenses a NEW pre-registered extreme-tail confirmatory round (next_probe P1), NOT an upgrade of this round.

size_tier_decomposition_DECISIVE.method: per-fy log_size tercile {small,mid,large}. extreme-tail (wd_strict) episodes split small 14 / mid 6 / large 9.
size_tier_decomposition_DECISIVE.finding: ALL 6 extreme-tail severe events come from SMALL-cap late filers. Mid- and large-cap extreme-late filers (15 episodes) had ZERO severe events. So the mechanism is 'small-cap AND extreme-late filing', not late filing per se. WITHIN small-caps it is NOT merely 'being small': extreme-late small filers have lift 12.2x vs the small-cap base rate (0.0351), and the controlled OR (6.19, size_z + year-FE) survives linear size adjustment. But the effect is confined to the small tier.
size_tier_decomposition_DECISIVE.deployment_implication: This is the honest reconciliation of R23's deployment-universe (K200uKQ150 large/mid) starvation: it is STRUCTURAL, not merely low-power. Large/mid caps that file extremely late do NOT subsequently fail (0 events / 15 episodes here); the signal lives entirely in small-caps OUTSIDE the deployment universe. Therefore even a confirmed extreme-tail signal has LIMITED deployment relevance for a K200uKQ150 long-only book — Stage-2 capital prospects remain dim regardless of confirmation.
size_tier_decomposition_DECISIVE.answer_to_mandated_concern1: The small-cap confound is REAL and material (all events small-cap) but is NOT a pure size-rediscovery: within-small extreme-late lift is 12x over the small base rate and OR survives size_z+year-FE. Honest label: 'small-cap-confined extreme-late-filing distress signal', deployment-conservative.

This is WHY the frozen p90 (which widened to any-late) failed while the strict tail succeeded.
